summary: [spec-fidelity] The chore marker is read by a stricter rule than 0.30's, so migrate turns an approved chore into a feature and still re-binds it. 0.30 kind_of_comments took the first canon:kind comment's second token, so <!-- canon:kind chore (ci) --> was a chore; 0.31 legacy_chore and rewrite need the exact tokens [canon:kind, chore], so equivalent sees Feature on both sides. Repro: the 0.30 clippy-ci brief with that marker, approved; migrate --commit re-binds it with no kind: chore, and brief check then gives 5 brief.section-missing blockers. Fix: read the old kind with the 0.30 rule in legacy_chore/rewrite, and refuse to re-bind when a canon:kind comment does not translate exactly.
